title: Los aranceles hunden en 60.000 millones las exportaciones europeas a EEUU
summary: Las ventas de bienes de la Unión Europea al mercado estadounidense se desplomaron un 19,8% entre enero y junio, hasta 246.196 millones de euros, mientras que el superávit comunitario se redujo a menos de la mitad. Leer

title: Tras el Mundial y el eclipse, volvemos a la dura realidad
summary: Los políticos suelen agarrarse a un clavo ardiendo para intentar que se olviden sus fracasos. Ha ocurrido siempre. Esta vez, el Gobierno se ha aferrado con fuerza al gran éxito español en el Mundial de Fútbol y al espectáculo del eclipse total de sol del 12 de agosto. Leer

title: El rancho en el que los CEO  sobrevivirán al apocalipsis
summary: Atraídos por paisajes agrestes y un presidente excéntrico, los ejecutivos están construyendo un refugio para el fin del mundo cerca de los Andes, en un terreno accidentado cinco veces mayor que Manhattan. Leer

title: Spain flood kills two and injures two babies
summary: A flood and a landslide triggered by torrential rain killed two women and injured two babies in rural northwestern Spain on Saturday, authorities said.

title: Five inspiring ideas for accessible holidays in Spain
summary: Those travelling with disabilities can find it very difficult, but thankfully there are several destinations in Spain which aim to make it easier with accessible transportation, museums and city streets.

title: EU pushes back as US revives trade pressure on bloc
summary: The EU pushed back Friday at renewed trade pressure from the United States, as Washington said the bloc was enabling Chinese evasion of US tariffs and stepped up calls for it to roll back flagship green rules on businesses.

title: Earthquake rocks Spanish city of Granada
summary: Spain's cherished tourist hotspot of Granada was in shock on Saturday after a rare 5.0-magnitude earthquake woke residents in the middle of the night and damaged buildings in the southern city.

title: Europe battles new wave of wildfires
summary: Countries across Europe on Saturday battled wildfires amid blistering temperatures and tinder-dry landscapes, with thousands of people evacuated.

title: Spain to tighten rules on bringing cash in from abroad
summary: The Spanish government is in the process of passing legislation which will automatically classify large amounts of undeclared cash brought into or taken out of the country as having been obtained illegally.

title: Everything you need to know about driving from Spain to Portugal
summary: If you're driving from Spain to Portugal, here's what you need to know about speed and alcohol limits, the regular toll and e-toll systems as well as other key considerations for a country with a different set of road rules.
